cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll serve. I've made you soup; the choir rejecting us doesn't mean you should miss dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've set a bowl for yourself too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you won't have to eat alone. I'll butter your bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit with me. I don't want you crying in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sit. Take my bread too; I can't swallow yet.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs serving; A3 turns A own meal into service to B; A5 yields to sitting but offers more bread while admitting inability to swallow.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 A bowl and B4 crying reveal shared distress already grounded in A1 rejection; A5 no swallowing explains the bread offer.

relationship.evidence: B2 notices the second place and B4 asks A to join instead of crying behind kitchen work.

heightening.evidence: B4 request changes A5 from service at a distance to sitting, with another caring gift that reveals A limit.

specificity.evidence: A1 soup and shared choir rejection make the domestic task and hurt clear.
